## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `dev` (not `main`, and not another PR's branch — see CONTRIBUTING.md on why stacking is risky here)
- [ ] Lint is clean (`cd persnallyd && npm run lint`)
- [ ] TypeScript compiles (`cd persnallyd && npm run build`)
- [ ] Tests pass (`cd persnallyd && npm test`)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or tokens in the diff
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
- [ ] Commit messages describe the "why"
